name: Guernsey (1936–1985)
description: A white field with a red Saint George's cross.
history: From 1936 Guernsey flew the plain cross of St George as its flag, identical to the flag of England. Because of the confusion this caused, a gold Norman cross was added within the red cross on 15 February 1985, the present flag, and the plain cross ceased to be used on 30 April 1985.
